name: @ramjet/transport-assisted
description: Browser half of the Ramjet assisted transport (implements ProxyTransport)

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=RamjetAssisted --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/assisted-transport.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/assisted-transport.mjs && tsc src/index.ts --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --allowImportingTsExtensions --skipLibCheck --target es2022 --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --outDir dist/types
